RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the March, 1, 2006/Phalguna 10, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
Financial incentives to producers of
Orthodox Tea
*141. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to provide financial incentives to the
producers of Orthodox Tea to arrest falling
exports and increase global market share;
(b) whether any strategy to increase
India's global market share in tea has been
evolved; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Terrorist activities in South India
†*142.SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
terrorist activities are on the rise in South
India;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons for the same;
(c) if so, the measures taken to stop the
same; and
(d) the efforts being made to block any
external assistance to the terrorists in the
Western coastal areas?
Strength of women police
*143. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the strength
of women police in the country is not even
2.5 per cent of the total strength of the men
police;
(b) whether it is also a fact that women
police in Andhra Pradesh is less than the
national average of 2.5 per cent when
compared to male police; and
(c) if so, what positive measures are
being taken by Government for gender
sensitization, including recruitment of
women in the State police services?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

46
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Allocation for rural water supply
scheme
*144. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the amount allocated to
the States under the rural water supply
scheme during the last three years and till
date, State-wise;
(b) the details of the amount utilized by
the States during this period; and
(c) the present status of the rural water
supply scheme in the country?
Rural development and infrastructure
creation
*145. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) the amount spent by Government
during the last two years for each scheme
of rural development, State-wise;
(b) whether Government have any
proposal to spend at least Rs. 1 lakh crores
in the coming year on rural development
and creation of infrastructure;
(c) if so, the schemes identified for this
purpose, State-wise; and
(d) the amount allocated for each scheme,
State-wise?
Growth rate of industrial production
*146. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the annual
growth rate of industrial production is
expected to increase in the current year as
compared to the last three years;
(b) if so, the actual growth rate during
the last three years and the estimated
growth rate for the year 2005-06;
(c) whether Government have also
identified those industries in which growth
rate is either increasing or decreasing, as
compared to the last three years; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Pak citizens living in India
†*147. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
thousands of Pak citizens are staying
illegally in the country for the last five years;
and
(b) whether it is a fact that the
Government of Haryana has sent any
information in this regard to the Central
Government?
Promotion of textile industry in
North Eastern States
†*148. SHRIMATI SUSHMA SWARAJ
: Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that traditional
apparels are being prepared in almost every
household in the North Eastern States like
a cottage industry;
(b) if so, whether Government are
considering to set up an institute like
National Institute of Fashion Technology
(NIFT) to promote textile industry there;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?

47
Coast Guard Station at Beypore,
Kerala
*149. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal  to
set up Coast Guard Station at Beypore in
Kerala;
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the land required and steps taken to acquire
the same, approval of the competent
authorities, fund sought and allotted, if any,
and the period of completion of the project;
and
(c) the number of Coast Guard Stations
in the Western coast, State-wise, as on date?

Beating Retreat, 2006

Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of the tickets sold f

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the March 1, 2006/Phalguna 10, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 155
Priority to Indian farmers' interests
in WTO negotiations
864. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE:
SHRI PRAMOD MAHAJAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the interests of farmers be
kept in mind while negotiating in the second
round of WTO negotiations since in India
million of farmers depend on agriculture;
(b) whether it is a fact that the developed
countries were requested to cut their trade
distorting agriculture subsidies by 83 per
cent and if so, what was their reaction;
(c) what action Government propose
to take to safeguard the interests of the
farmers; and
(d) whether provisions will be made to
safeguard food and livelihood securities and
rural development?
Expansion of ITPO Chennai
865. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian Trade Promotion
Organisation at Chennai is being expanded;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Discontinuance of subsidy on export
of agro-products by US and EU
†866. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in the sixth
minister level meeting under WTO, America
and European countries had agreed to
discontinue subsidy on export of agro-
products;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

198
(c) whether any decision has been
arrived at with regard to subsidy on the
production of agro-products; and
(d) if so, the details of the said decision?
New facilities for setting up SEZs
†867. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is  a fact that Government
have recently announced new facilities for
setting up new Special Economic Zones;
(b) if so, the details of facilities and new
facilities added recently;
(c) the estimated number of new Special
Economic Zones likely to come up as result
of these new facilities; and
(d) the number of units in each of the
zones?
Employment opportunities in SEZs
†868. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that capital
investment to the tune of Rs. 1 lakh
thousand crores has been assessed to be
made through the industrial units
established in Special Economic Zones in
the next three years;
(b) whether it has also been  inter alia
assessed about the creation of around 5 lakh
new employment opportunities in the next
three years;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) the basis on which the said
assessment have been made by
Government; and
(e) the details of said basis and the
number of employment opportunities that
will be created for specialists, trained and
untrained labourers out of said 5 lakh job
opportunities?
Import of consumer and capital goods
†869. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that import of
consumer goods has increased by 18.9 per
cent in the year 2005 in the country;
(b) if not,  the facts in this regard;
(c) whether Government have assessed
an increase in the import of Capital Goods;
and
(d) if so, the details of such increase
and the value of industrial raw material
imported in the said period?
Share of industrial units in SEZ in
GDP
†870. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that any
assessment with regard to share of
industrial units established in Special
Economic Zones (SEZs) in GDP has been
made;
(b) if so, the share of industrial units
established in SEZs in the country, in the
GDP during year 2000-2001, 2002-2003
and 2004-2005; and
(c) to what extent the share of industrial
sector as a whole in GDP was assessed
during the said year?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

199
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Hong Kong ministerial meeting of
WTO
871. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
SHRI MANOJ
BHATTACHARYA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what strategy had been evolved at
the Hong Kong ministerial meet of WTO,
to help the Indian farmer and agriculture-
based industry against dumping of
agricultural products in the market;
(b) whether Indian does not favour
linking reduction in agriculture subsidy with
other issues like market access and reduction
in custom duties in the light of the
decisions taken at the Doha round of
negotiations; and
(c) what specific steps are contemplated
to be decided upon  f
